data.other_hard: regularly enrolled at a German higher education institution; completed first year of study (Bachelor's students only); enrolled at a higher education institution participating in Erasmus+ whose home institution has signed an Erasmus cooperation agreement with the receiving institution; at least second year of study
data.evidence_sentence: The programme is intended for students who are regularly enrolled at a German higher education institution, have completed their first year of study (only applicable to Bachelor's students), are enrolled at a higher education institution participating in the Erasmus+ project AND whose home institution has signed an Erasmus cooperation agreement with the receiving institution.
data.notes: Page describes Erasmus+ mobility for study periods and traineeships in Erasmus+ programme countries; host country not fixed by the page, so left empty. Funding amount not stated; sponsored students are exempt from host institution tuition and fees, so funding_type set to partial (fee exemption only, no stated stipend). Deadlines must be requested from home institution; none stated. Page text has inconsistent academic requirements (regularly enrolled and first year completed vs. at least second year of study); the Academic Requirements section also says open to all students at participating institutions. Nationality not stated. Degree levels inferred from duration text covering Bachelor's, Master's and doctoral students.
